run_qwen_1m_offline: run the qwen 1m offline example to generate text with a 600k token prompt using vLLM
initialize_llm_engine: initialize a vLLM engine with the Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M model and 1M context length
create_sampling_params: create sampling parameters with temperature, top_p, top_k, and repetition penalty for text generation
process_llm_requests: process a list of prompts through the LLM and print generated text with prompt length
load_prompt_from_url: load a test prompt from a remote URL for long context testing
